name: stremio-skip-addon
description: A self-hosted Stremio stream addon that cuts intro, recap, credits and preview segments out of HLS streams using TheIntroDB timings.
author: TheIntroDB

TIDB_API_KEY.description: **Required.** Your [TheIntroDB API key](https://theintrodb.org/docs). Anonymous lookups are rate limited per IP, and every Worker shares Cloudflare's egress addresses, so the addon refuses to look anything up without a key of its own.
